findings.title: OpenDiscoveryTrace headline success denominator is exactly reconstructible
findings.observation: The public frontier analysis contains 372 trajectories and per-model process metrics n=124, but success drops null values and has n=43/42/42. The aggregate 0.6929133858267716 is exactly 88/127, leaving 245/372 rows with success=null.
findings.scope_guard: This is denominator reconstruction, not scientific correctness.

findings.title: OpenDiscoveryTrace non-null success statuses have heterogeneous semantics
findings.observation: Harness source assigns success by crude whitespace-token-set ground-truth overlap >0.3 only when both a final claim and ground_truth exist, returns null for a claim without ground_truth, and forces false when no final claim exists. The fixed task bank contributes 42 ground-truth frontier tasks, yielding 126 overlap-scored records over three models; one Claude no-claim record supplies the 127th non-null false. Verification remains serialized as pending.
findings.scope_guard: Do not call the headline approximately-69-percent rate 372 completed verifier judgments. Medium success_rate=0 is not evidence all medium tasks failed; it is driven by one non-null forced failure among otherwise null outcomes.

findings.title: Audit-Closed final admission arithmetic is Chat-native replayable from declarative bytes
findings.observation: Public source defines alpha_epoch=total_alpha*(1-decay)*decay^epoch and threshold=candidate_count/alpha_epoch, accepting iff max e-value reaches threshold. A protocol-local transcript with epoch0, alpha .05, decay .5, two candidates and e-values 100/20 recomputes alpha_epoch .025, threshold 80, winner A, accepted=true without package/model regeneration.
findings.scope_guard: Synthetic control for final decision replay only; real trials still need hash-chain, commitment, evaluation and e-value provenance.

findings.title: Outcome denominator and verifier provenance is now fail-closed
findings.observation: p1-protocol-065 binds population coverage, row-level evaluator/pending/forced-failure classes, exact verifier semantics and recomputable numerator/denominator. Its dependency-free validator matched 5/5 adversarial expected semantic outcomes.
